'''De Ruiter''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Dutch National Championship]] on 21 May 2000 with [[Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control|Corulag Operatives / Biker Troopers]], according to Johan van der Meer's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d808">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-25-amterdam-21-may-2000d808/ amterdam-21-may-2000], DeckTech (Johan "Johan" van der Meer, 25 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-25-amterdam-21-may-2000d808/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
